Cache framework calls unserialize(file_get_contents($path . $filename)). If cache directory is writable by other processes or $filename derives from user input without strict normalization, classic CWE-502 RCE via crafted cache file. Common framework vuln pattern.

GitHub Actions workflow. inputs.free-threading is boolean-typed; the conditional expression evaluates to one of two static literal strings (--disable-gil or empty). All other shell commands use constant arguments. No user-controlled shell command construction.

DOMDocument::loadXML($content, LIBXML_DTDLOAD) enables external DTD loading on user-supplied MathML content. Without LIBXML_NONET this allows XXE: external entity reads (local file disclosure) and SSRF via DTD fetches. Textbook CWE-611.

Run(cmd) wrapper with subprocess.check_call(shell=True) is an anti-pattern, but in this benchmark script all visible callers pass static string templates with constant arguments. No user input flows in. Internal benchmark tool context.

Same pattern as hl2_076: $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] (or JSON input) flows to require_once + class instantiation + dynamic method call. Arbitrary code execution by authenticated user. Real bug; claimed CWE-918 wrong category but verdict is TP.
